touches.text: Machine: the operator inbox builds the to-do list from live state, storing nothing (the operator_inbox tool, 17.14).
cairn operator inbox (the to-do list); cairn review <id> "<words>".
operator_inbox: builds the operator's to-do list from live state, storing nothing (7.3.7). USERS: Operator.
charter: compiles a component's bounded state from its history. WHY: state is compiled from the component's tickets, never hand-edited (Law 5). Held by CodeMother.

Any device or machine may have a bin/ beside its code. That folder IS its list of shortcuts: add a file to add one, delete it to remove one. A shortcut is a script that calls the long form (eg `cairn superclaude` -> `cairn cc superclaude`; `cairn show temp` -> `cairn recovery show temp`), which also saves the walk from searching farther, or does work itself (eg install). Shortcuts live beside what they serve (RULE 1). `cairn foo` whose first word is not a device means `cairn cairn foo`: top-level shortcuts are the cairn device's bin/.
Every verb anywhere is reached from the cairn command, as a path: cairn <device> [<machine> ...] <verb>. There is no central list.
